headline: Democrats win both the House and Senate in the midterms
summary: Networks projected Democratic control of both chambers after flips in Kansas, Iowa, Texas, Ohio, Maine and both Carolinas, setting up divided government for Trump's last two years. Hakeem Jeffries is in line for Speaker.

headline: Final counts: Mississippi and Alaska Senate races still open
summary: By the AP's count Democrats hold 54 Senate seats to 44 with two races uncalled. A House vote on impeaching Defense Secretary Hegseth could come this week, and Stephen Miller was named White House chief of staff.

headline: Democratic Congress expected to push on health care costs
summary: With both chambers, Democrats plan to try restoring enhanced ACA subsidies and reversing Medicaid cuts, and House leaders say ending the Iran war is an early priority.

headline: Trump says new Iran strikes 'highly unlikely' if Tehran makes a nuclear deal
summary: He tied avoiding renewed war to progress on a nuclear agreement and reopening the Strait of Hormuz, said a land blockade is now in effect, and will host Qatar's prime minister on Monday as mediation intensifies.

headline: Tankers catch fire in the Strait of Hormuz
summary: Iran says several tankers caught fire, one after hitting a mine east of the strait, while the IRGC warns it is ready to respond to any renewed US strikes.

headline: Trump to raise Iran with Xi and Putin at next week's APEC summit
summary: The president says he expects to discuss the war and 'denuclearisation' with China's and Russia's leaders.

headline: Israel's president asks Gadi Eisenkot, not Netanyahu, to form a government
summary: Neither man won a majority, and Israel's main parties recommended Eisenkot, Netanyahu's chief rival.

headline: AI-regulation fears drive the worst stock day since April 2025
summary: On Thursday the S&P 500 fell 4.4% and the chip index more than 12%, as investors priced in tighter AI-infrastructure rules after the Democratic wins.

headline: Hot jobs report lifts odds of a December rate hike
summary: October payrolls rose 165,000 and unemployment fell to 4.1%, pushing the 10-year yield to about 4.86%. Chip stocks bounced Friday, but the S&P 500 still lost about 2.7% on the week.

headline: This week hinges on the CPI inflation report
summary: Strategists see consumer prices as the swing factor: a cool core reading would ease hike fears, while a hot one could extend last week's selloff.

headline: Marvell agrees to buy Lumentum in a roughly $115 billion stock deal
summary: Reported by CNBC as the largest public-tech acquisition on record, combining two AI data-center networking suppliers.

headline: Apple Intelligence comes to mainland China in December
summary: Apple says the first features reach China with iOS 27.3, with developer testing under way.

headline: Palo Alto Networks reportedly in talks to buy agentic-AI security startup Clutch
summary: The deal under discussion is about $500 million.

headline: US homelessness posts its biggest drop in over a decade
summary: The count fell from record highs but is still near 700,000; the administration and advocates credit different causes.

headline: Pope Leo XIV starts a Latin America tour weeks after cancer surgery
summary: The three-nation trip opened in Uruguay, three weeks after lung surgery had put it in doubt.

headline: Flint newborn deaths fell by half after a cash-for-families program
summary: A new study found neonatal mortality dropped 50% after Rx Kids began giving cash to expecting and new parents.
